Bug_Title: SA: Nonsensical self computation involving a variable (e.g., x & x) (SA_LOCAL_SELF_COMPUTATION)
Bug_Details:
This method performs a nonsensical computation of a local variable with another
reference to the same variable (e.g., x&x or x-x). Because of the nature
of the computation, this operation doesn't seem to make sense,
and may indicate a typo or a logic error. Double-check the computation.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where the variable 'x' is involved in a nonsensical self-computation using the bitwise AND operator (x & x). This operation does not change the value of 'x' and seems to be a logical error or typo.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method with an input of 5. The showBug method contains a nonsensical self-computation (x & x), which returns the original value of x. The test expects the result to be 10, which is incorrect, causing the test to fail and thus triggering the bug.
